items.title: What Could Go Wrong At Micron From Here?
items.summary: You own Micron Technology (MU) for its memory boom, and the worry is competition. The boom itself shows in the numbers. Micron's revenue over the last twelve months was $90.3 billion, against $33.8 billion a year earlier. The company is now valued at about $1.09 trillion, so a dent in those sales would matter to you. Which memory rivals should you watch, and how close are they.

items.title: S&P Global raises Western Digital outlook to positive on surging AI demand
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings has revised its outlook on Western Digital Corporation (NASDAQ:WDC) to positive from stable while affirming its 'BBB-' issuer credit rating, pointing to accelerating cash flow generation and sustained low leverage. The revision signals potential upward mobility for the data storage manufacturer's credit profile as booming demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure fuels rapid top-line growth.

items.title: Western Digital, FormFactor, Penguin Solutions, Himax, and Power Integrations Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know
items.summary: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after benchmark 10-year U.S. Treasury yields rose above 5.1%, renewing pressure on high-multiple technology valuations. The pullback follows a six-session climb that had lifted the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index by 14% since the start of the week, according to Nasdaq index data.
